title: WhiteBIT Integrates Lightning Network for Fast and Cheap Bitcoin Transactions
summary: Bitcoin Magazine WhiteBIT Integrates Lightning Network for Fast and Cheap Bitcoin Transactions The Swiss crypto exchange has onboarded the Lightning Network to help people withdraw and deposit bitcoin with ease. This post WhiteBIT Integrates Lightning Network for Fast and Cheap Bitcoin Transactions first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
